title: 不只是赔钱：是要改Meta的商业模式，29州联合起诉能逼它改吗？
speaker: Rob Bonta

segments.en: you know this isn't the first case it's not going to be probably the last case against meta or social media at large
segments.zh: 这不是第一起案件，可能也不是最后一起针对Meta或整个社交媒体的案件

segments.en: but it does seem to be the biggest case so far to date why is this one so important
segments.zh: 但这似乎是迄今最大的案件，为什么这起如此重要？

segments.en: and is it about restitution for those families and individuals who you would argue in the other states have been certainly harmed here
segments.zh: 这是否关乎对受害家庭和个人的赔偿？

segments.en: or is it about really changing the way social media companies met meta in particular do business
segments.zh: 还是为了真正改变社交媒体公司，尤其是Meta的商业模式？

segments.en: it's both it's about in jugged of relief including changing their conduct ending the features that create the excessive the addictive the compulsive use by kids
segments.zh: 两者都有。这关乎救济，包括改变他们的行为，终止导致孩子过度、上瘾、强迫性使用的功能

segments.en: that the features that are designed to a dick kids so that they maximize their use that the duration on the platform the frequency on the platform
segments.zh: 这些功能旨在吸引孩子，最大化他们在平台上的使用时长和频率

segments.en: so it's certainly about changing these addictive harmful features that meta do about and light about it
segments.zh: 所以这当然关乎改变Meta这些上瘾、有害的功能

segments.en: it's also about an appropriate amount of what we call penalties it's not actually technically damages penalties disengagement and restitution are the types of relief we can get
segments.zh: 也关乎我们所说的适当处罚。实际上，处罚、追缴和赔偿是我们能获得的救济类型

segments.en: we are seeking significant amounts in this case and this is a huge case it's a multi-state case
segments.zh: 我们在这起案件中寻求巨额赔偿，这是一起跨州大案

segments.en: it's what we call a bell weather case when 29 states have brought case claims
segments.zh: 我们称之为风向标案件，29个州提起了诉讼

segments.en: and four states have been chosen to bring their case to trial and so california calorado kentucky and New Jersey will be bringing our case on Tuesday
segments.zh: 四个州被选中进行审判，加州、科罗拉多、肯塔基和新泽西将在周二开庭

segments.en: and across the country there are north of 40 states bipartisan and democratic states who have brought cases against meta in both state court and in federal court
segments.zh: 全国有超过40个州，两党都有，在州法院和联邦法院对Meta提起了诉讼

segments.en: so this is a big moment this is a big case we're seeking both changes in conduct and appropriate financial compensation
segments.zh: 所以这是一个重要时刻，我们既寻求行为改变，也寻求适当的财务赔偿
